## Type of Change

<!-- Pick one. If more than one applies, consider splitting the PR (see CONTRIBUTING.md). -->

- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `feat`: New feature
- [ ] `perf`: Performance improvement
- [ ] `refactor`: Restructuring with no change in behavior
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation only
- [ ] `test`: Tests only
- [ ] `style`: Formatting only
- [ ] `ci` / `build`: CI, packaging, or build system
- [ ] **Breaking change** (changes existing behavior or public API)

## Verification

<!-- How was this tested? For rendering, radiometric or numerical changes, say how you checked

## Checklist

- [ ] The PR does one thing, and nothing unfinished is exposed (`huira.hpp`, handles, Python bindings, docs)
- [ ] Tests are added or updated, and a bug fix includes a test that fails without the fix
- [ ] Python bindings and documentation are updated for any changed public API
- [ ] Code is formatted with the repository's `.clang-format` and follows the naming conventions
- [ ] The branch is rebased on `main`, with review fixes folded into the commits they fix
